summary: The insertion free-space check counts the raw payload length, but allocation reserves at least 4 bytes per cell. A 3-byte cell therefore passes the check with 5 free bytes despite requiring 6 bytes including its pointer, causing cell content to overlap the pointer array. The fix checks the minimum allocation size so the cell takes the overflow path. This reversal isolates that correction; the selected unit test was added by the fix. No tests were executed.
expected_failure: cell content area overlaps cell pointer array
